name: Sanctioning of Tricycles of Orthopedically Challenged
teBrief: "ఆర్థోపెడికల్లీ ఛాలెంజ్డ్ ట్రైసైకిళ్ల మంజూరు" పథకం ఆర్థోపెడికల్లీ ఛాలెంజ్డ్ వ్యక్తులకు వారి కదలిక మరియు స్వాతంత్ర్యాన్ని పెంచడానికి ట్రైసైకిళ్లను అందించడం లక్ష్యంగా పెట్టుకుంది.
brief: The A.P. Differently Abled & Senior Citizens Assistance Corporation, Andhra Pradesh, under its Action Plan 2017-18, aims to provide tricycles to orthopedically challenged individuals to enhance their mobility and independence.
briefFull: The "Sanctioning of Tricycles of Orthopedically Challenged" scheme aims to provide tricycles to orthopedically challenged individuals to enhance their mobility and independence. This initiative ensures that eligible individuals receive the necessary support to lead active and self-reliant lives.
details: The A.P. Differently Abled & Senior Citizens Assistance Corporation, Andhra Pradesh, under its Action Plan 2017-18, aims to provide tricycles to orthopedically challenged individuals to enhance their mobility and independence. The tricycles are distributed by the Assistant Directors, Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled & Senior Citizens, and District Managers, A.P. Differently Abled & Senior Citizens Assistance Corporation.
benefits: - Eligible beneficiaries receive a free tricycle to improve their mobility and independence.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should have 40% or above disability and meet the eligibility criteria as specified in the [RPwD Act, 2016](https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s3e58aea67b01fa747687f038dfde066f6/uploads/2023/10/202310161053958942.pdf).1. The applicant should be eligible for sanction only once in three years.
1. The applicant's family annual income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-.
howToApply:
[Online]
**Step 01:** Visit the official website: [https://apdascac.ap.gov.in](https://apdascac.ap.gov.in)
**Step 02:** On the homepage, click on "[APDASCAC Schemes](https://apdascac.ap.gov.in/APDASCAC-Schemes/)".
**Step 03:** Select the "SANCTION OF TRICYCLES" option.
**Step 04:** Click on "[Apply Now](https://apdascac.ap.gov.in/Forms/tricycles/)" to begin the application process.
**Step 05:** Fill in the required details and submit your application.
documentsRequired:
1. Disability Certificate.
1. Aadhaar Card.
1. Caste Certificate in case of SC/ST/BC.
1. Passport size photo.
1. Latest Income Certificate/ BPL Ration Card.

faqs.q: What is the purpose of the Tricycle distribution scheme?
faqs.a: The scheme aims to provide tricycles to orthopedically challenged individuals to enhance their mobility and independence.
faqs.qTe: ట్రైసైకిల్ పంపిణీ పథకం యొక్క ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి?

faqs.q: Who is eligible to receive a tricycle under this scheme?
faqs.a:
To be eligible for the DAISY Player Sanction Scheme, the applicant must meet the following criteria:

1. The applicant should have 40% or above disability and must fulfill the eligibility conditions as specified under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act, 2016.
1. The applicant is eligible for sanction only once in three years.
1. The applicant's family annual income should not exceed ₹3.00 lakhs.
faqs.qTe: ఈ పథకం కింద ట్రైసైకిల్ పొందడానికి ఎవరు అర్హులు?

faqs.q: How often can an individual receive a tricycle under this scheme?
faqs.a: An individual can receive a tricycle once every three years.
faqs.qTe: ఈ పథకం కింద ఒక వ్యక్తి ఎంత తరచుగా ట్రైసైకిల్ను పొందవచ్చు?

faqs.q: What happens if the tricycle is damaged or requires maintenance?
faqs.a: Maintenance and repair responsibilities are usually not covered by the scheme; beneficiaries should refer to the guidelines or contact the distribution office for specific assistance.
faqs.qTe: ట్రైసైకిల్ దెబ్బతిన్నట్లయితే లేదా నిర్వహణ అవసరమైతే ఏమి జరుగుతుంది?

faqs.q: What measures are in place to prevent double or false claims?
faqs.a: Records of beneficiaries are maintained by the Assistant Directors and District Managers to avoid double or false claims.
faqs.qTe: డబుల్ లేదా తప్పుడు క్లెయిమ్లను నివారించడానికి ఏ చర్యలు ఉన్నాయి?

faqs.q: Who is responsible for distributing the tricycles?
faqs.a: The tricycles are distributed through the Assistant Directors, Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled & Senior Citizens, and the District Managers of the A.P. Differently Abled & Senior Citizens Assistance Corporation.

faqs.q: How is the tricycle distributed to the beneficiary?
faqs.a: The tricycle is distributed directly by the Assistant Directors or District Managers of the respective departments.

faqs.q: What should a beneficiary do if their application is denied?
faqs.a: They can inquire about the reasons for denial and may reapply if they address the specified issues or seek assistance from the concerned authorities.
faqs.qTe: వారి దరఖాస్తు తిరస్కరించబడితే లబ్ధిదారుడు ఏమి చేయాలి?

faqs.q: What documents are required to apply for a tricycle?
faqs.a:
- Disability Certificate.
- Aadhaar Card.
- Caste Certificate in case of SC/ST/BC.
- Passport size photo.
- Latest Income Certificate/ BPL Ration Card.
faqs.qTe: ట్రైసైకిల్ కోసం దరఖాస్తు చేయడానికి ఏ పత్రాలు అవసరం?
